column1: # Benchmark workload table (plan 08-18, D-21 to D-24, D-39): read by tools/bench/bench.c (ivs-bench), never by the gate.
# One workload per line, seven columns separated by one TAB each (the last column is free text):
#   workload scenario warmup iterations roundtrip_ticks ticks note
# workload: the id printed in the first column of a row of the output; scenario: the id of a scenario of data/scenarios whose
# repeatability golden data/golden/<scenario>.digests the tool compares with its own report before it reads a clock; warmup and
# iterations: the fixed untimed and timed iteration counts (never a wall-time budget); roundtrip_ticks: 0, or the cadence of the
# round-trip hook (save, reset and restore at every multiple of it, plan 08-16) that the tool passes to every execution of the
# workload (plan 08-19: the snapshot workload); ticks: the final machine time of the golden (its last step.<k>.now_ticks), checked
# against the run; note: what the workload exercises. No workload is labelled cpu-bound: none is (08-DISCUSS-perf 2.3).
